method: Off/on/off Vmid-between-channel control. Each capture has one-second warm-up and twelve-second measurement, all 50 normal ADC-ordered routes, 10 MHz blocking/manual/repeat1, reference 2.5 V, profile off. Existing firmware vmid command inserts two channel15 operations after every route; only sensor-route samples are retained.
hardware_state: Both strips remain unplugged, GUI disconnected; laptop charger connected. One Vmid bias resistor per ADC at shared MXO/op-amp input.
limitations: Vmid insertion changes acquisition cadence, revisit time, analog MUX history and digital command pattern together. Sensor strips remain unplugged and inputs lack individual bias. Vmid conversions are discarded by current firmware, not exported as raw reference samples.
